title: Longest Common Subsequence - Solution
intuition: Given two strings text1 and text2, return the length of their longest common subsequence.
step_by_step_explanation: Iterate through elements and apply logic accordingly.
common_mistakes: Use 2D DP matrix. If text1[i] == text2[j], dp[i][j] = dp[i-1][j-1] + 1. Else, max(dp[i-1][j], dp[i][j-1]).
